card_name: HDFC Bank Corporate Platinum Credit Card
reward_structure:
• For every Rs.150 spent, 3 reward points are added.
• Accelerated reward points of 10X on expense with merchant partners
• Fuel surcharge waiver for all fuel transactions.
• Exclusive airport lounge access.
key_highlights:
• 24*7 MIS availability
• Spending analysis offered by category
• Expense reports

benefits_features.Lounge Access Benefits: With this Corporate Platinum card, you can avail up to 8 Airport lounges in the country/year on a complimentary basis.
benefits_features.Fuel Benefits:
• Fuel surcharge will be waived by 1% on all the purchase happening between Rs.500-Rs.5000.
• This waiver will be applicable at petrol pumps in the country.
benefits_features.Insurance Benefits:
• With this credit card, the bank offers you an air accident insurance of Rs.1 crore.
• For accidental death in road or train travel, the insurance coverage offered is Rs.10lakh.

how_tos.To redeem your points online, here are t:
• Login to your HDFC Bank net banking account.
• Click on ‘credit cards’.
• Register the credit card to the redeem reward points and select ‘continue’.
• You will be redirected to the reward redemption page.
• Click on ‘Redeem Reward Points’.
• Select the category of the item you need.
• Once done, choose the points range to check the various products.
• You can select the items and add them to your cart.
• To check this products you have chosen, click on ‘view your shopping cart’.
• Read the terms and conditions and check the box.
• Click on ‘submit’. An redemption order number which is given must be noted for future references.

reward_point_benefits:
• For every Rs.150 spent you will get 2 reward points per card.
• The reward points will be subjected to a maximum of 4000 points per statement cycle.
• These points can also be redeemed against AirMiles as well.

fees_and_charges.Cash advance limit:
40% of the credit limit - Corporate Liability
50% of credit limit - Individual Liability
fees_and_charges.Cash advance charges: 2.5% of the amount withdrawn or Rs.500, whichever is higher
fees_and_charges.Charges on over limit account: 2.5% of the over limit amount subjected to a minimum of Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Payment return charges: 2% of the payment amount subjected to a minimum of Rs.450
fees_and_charges.Balance transfer processing charge: 1% of the balance transfer amount or Rs.250. The higher amount will be taken.
fees_and_charges.Fuel surcharge transaction charges: 1% surcharge will be waived off. Maximum waiver is Rs.50 per statement cycle
fees_and_charges.Overdue charges processing charges:
Corporate up to Rs.5,000: Rs.25
Charge valued more than Rs.5,000: Rs.50

miscellaneous: The credit card limit will be at the discretion of the bank as well as the business or corporate company. However, the general factors for the credit limit will all be taken into consideration such as your credit score report as well as your repayment habits of your past and any ongoing loans.

faqs.What is the cash advance fee levied on e: The cash advance fee levied on the withdrawal using your Corporate Platinum Credit Card is 2.5% of the amount withdrawn or Rs. 500, whichever is higher.
faqs.How is over limit charge calculated on m: Over limit charges are levied on the outstanding amount that exceed the credit limit. The over limit charge is 2.5% of the over limit amount, or Rs.500, whichever is higher.
faqs.From when is the interest charge on cash: Finance charges applicable on cash advance made accrue from the date of transaction till date of repayment.
faqs.What is the charge levied on exceeding t: For overdue charges levied on transaction of less than or equal to Rs. 5000, the charge levied is Rs.25; and for charge of value more than Rs. 5000, the fee levied is Rs.50.
faqs.Are any charges levied on foreign curren: Yes, the charges levied is 2.5% on foreign currency transaction.
